title: President of the Galaxy V2
tagline: More human. More fingers. Same impossible office.
provenance: Q888 human drawing over the original AI-generated figure | Second presidential edition, 2026
imageAlt: President of the Galaxy V2 die-cut sticker: pastel hand-drawn mushroom figure over a robotic body, two raised middle fingers and rearranged yellow and orange lettering
description:
A small update for an unnecessarily large office. The President has been redesigned. Not replaced. Improved.

The original AI-generated figure remains underneath, but significantly more of it has now been covered, interrupted and reorganised by human drawing. White lines reclaim the surface. Gold survives where appropriate. Orange has been authorised for official presidential typography.

And, after extensive diplomatic research: one additional middle finger. The President can now perform the Peace On gesture with both hands, providing approximately twice the intergalactic peace experience.

The words have also been unscrewed. Their order is now negotiable. GALAXY, TOGETHER, SCREW, PRESIDENT and STARS can be read differently. All readings have presidential approval.

Edition: 10.
